messages:
morgan: @here PR #27111 is blocked by a flaky CI failure on integ-shard7 only. Need one maintainer approval to merge or we can run a targeted rerun. build: https://buildkite.example/builds/12345
ci-bot: Build 12345 failed: integ-shard7 — test 'embedding-index-consistency' timed out after 30m
ryan: logs ->
ryan: ```
ERROR: Timeout waiting for embedding flush
  at embedding/indexer.go:412
  kv_eviction: eviction loop detected delay > 200ms
```
sasha: I can repro locally with shard7 sim. looks like KV eviction timing + a race with the flush goroutine. low frequency but hits CI under load
alejandro: If it's a timing flake we should avoid a snapshot update. Prefer targeted rerun + add a retry hook. I can approve after a green rerun
morgan: @ci-bot can you kick a targeted rerun for shard7 only? command we use: `/ci rerun --targeted=shard7 --preserve-cache`
ci-bot: @morgan targeting rerun queued: https://buildkite.example/builds/12346 (queued)
sasha: ack — watching the build. if it flakes again i'll try a bisection and post a small repro script
ryan: quick question — any recent kv manager changes in the last week? might be related
alejandro: only a micro-optimization in pr #27090 (eviction batching), but I left a safety throttle. could still interact with timing under stress
sasha: build 12346 started -> looks like the same test but much faster env startup this time
sasha: rerun passed ✅ — build 12346 green. no snapshot diff
alejandro: dropping approval now. LGTM :+1: merging when CI is green end-to-end
morgan: thanks! I'll merge and open a follow-up to add a retry wrapper for the embedding-index test and a small monitoring alert for consecutive shard failures
deploy-bot: merged PR #27111 into main (by morgan) — https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/27111/merge
morgan: created GH issue #487 to track: "CI: add targeted retry for embedding-index flaky on shard7" and assigned to @sasha
summary: PR blocked by shard-specific flaky test; targeted rerun passed; approval granted; PR merged; follow-up issue created
